description: This Java class defines a 'Field' object used for representing fields within a hardware configuration or data structure, including methods for command generation, parsing responses, and managing field properties.

classes.name: Field
classes.description: Represents a hardware or data field with properties such as name, offset, type, bit offset, and options, with methods for command creation and response parsing.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field.

methods.name: setCommand
methods.description: Generates the command string to set the value of the field based on its type.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Generates the command string to retrieve the value of the field.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset of the field.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns the options associated with the field.

methods.name: getBitOffset
methods.description: Returns the bit offset if applicable.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the field.

methods.name: isIntValueMessage
methods.description: Checks if the message is an integer value message.

methods.name: isBitValueMessage
methods.description: Checks if the message is a bit value message.

methods.name: isFloatValueMessage
methods.description: Checks if the message is a float value message.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses a response message to extract index and value, could be integer or float.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Field object.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory methods to create and register new Field instances with various parameters.
